title: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
abstract: arXiv:2611.07663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. translated_title: 面向低功耗机器人自主的能耗感知开放词汇检测调度
translated_abstract: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）使机器人能够搜索运行时的目标物体查询，但固定频率的推理会在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视角期间，将嵌入式计算资源浪费在低价值帧上。本文提出了一种面向低功耗移动机器人的能耗感知OVD调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度，在Jetson Orin Nano上于低、中、高功耗的YOLO-World-S模式之间进行切换。我们在AgileX LIMO机器人上通过40次真实导航试验评估了能耗与检测质量的权衡：包括两个目标物体、每个目标-策略对五种放置位置以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子的试验中，该调度器取得了8/10的任务成功率，相比之下各固定频率基线为7/10；同时相对于8 Hz高频率基线，将Jetson平均输入功耗（一种Jetson侧功耗指标）降低了5.2%，并将实际OVD调用频率降低了34.0%。它并不最小化任务窗口内的Je……
tldr: 本文提出一种能耗感知的开放词汇目标检测调度器，利用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度在Jetson Orin Nano上动态切换不同功耗的检测模式，在真实导航试验中将任务成功率从7/10提升至8/10，同时将平均功耗降低5.2%、检测调用频率降低34.0%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an energy-aware open-vocabulary detection scheduler that dynamically switches among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano using odometry, map change, and detector confidence, improving mission success from 7/10 to 8/10 while cutting mean power draw by 5.2% and OVD call rate by 34.0% in real navigation trials.
